questiontext.text:
Consider the following matrices:

\[ A = {@mats[1]@}, \quad B = {@mats[2]@}, \quad C = {@mats[3]@} \]

\[ D = {@mats[4]@}, \quad E = {@mats[5]@}, \quad F = {@mats[6]@} \]

(a) For each type below, tick every matrix that is of that type. A matrix may belong to more than one type.

Remember that a rectangular matrix must have a different number of rows and columns, it cannot be square.

(i) Null matrices:[[input:cbnull]] [[validation:cbnull]] [[feedback:prtnull]]
(ii) Square matrices:[[input:cbsquare]] [[validation:cbsquare]] [[feedback:prtsquare]]
(iii) Rectangular matrices:[[input:cbrect]] [[validation:cbrect]] [[feedback:prtrect]]
(iv) Identity matrices:[[input:cbident]] [[validation:cbident]] [[feedback:prtident]]
(v) Row matrices:[[input:cbrow]] [[validation:cbrow]] [[feedback:prtrow]]
(vi) Column matrices:[[input:cbcol]] [[validation:cbcol]] [[feedback:prtcol]]

(b) Write down the order of each matrix: the number of rows in the first box and the number of columns in the second.

\(A:\)[[input:rowA]] [[validation:rowA]]\(\times\)[[input:colA]] [[validation:colA]][[feedback:prtordA]]
\(B:\)[[input:rowB]] [[validation:rowB]]\(\times\)[[input:colB]] [[validation:colB]][[feedback:prtordB]]
\(C:\)[[input:rowC]] [[validation:rowC]]\(\times\)[[input:colC]] [[validation:colC]][[feedback:prtordC]]
\(D:\)[[input:rowD]] [[validation:rowD]]\(\times\)[[input:colD]] [[validation:colD]][[feedback:prtordD]]
\(E:\)[[input:rowE]] [[validation:rowE]]\(\times\)[[input:colE]] [[validation:colE]][[feedback:prtordE]]
\(F:\)[[input:rowF]] [[validation:rowF]]\(\times\)[[input:colF]] [[validation:colF]][[feedback:prtordF]]

generalfeedback.text:
The order of a matrix is its number of rows \(\times\) its number of columns. The types are: null (every entry is 0); square (equal numbers of rows and columns); rectangular (rows and columns differ – this includes row and column matrices); identity (square, with 1s on the leading diagonal and 0s elsewhere); row (a single row); column (a single column).

For this version:

  • Null: \({@key_null@}\)
  • Square: \({@key_square@}\)
  • Rectangular: \({@key_rect@}\)
  • Identity: \({@key_ident@}\)
  • Row: \({@key_row@}\)
  • Column: \({@key_col@}\)

Orders: \(A:{@nrows[1]@}\times{@ncols[1]@}\), \(B:{@nrows[2]@}\times{@ncols[2]@}\), \(C:{@nrows[3]@}\times{@ncols[3]@}\), \(D:{@nrows[4]@}\times{@ncols[4]@}\), \(E:{@nrows[5]@}\times{@ncols[5]@}\), \(F:{@nrows[6]@}\times{@ncols[6]@}\).
